city.summary_zh: 国际枢纽+山海，租金是亚洲最贵一档，适合项目制短住。

neighborhoods.name: 中环 Central
neighborhoods.vibe: 金融中心，办公室/协同办公与夜生活最密
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 expatexchange 区间 HK$20,000–30,000 中值（HK$25,000÷7.8）

neighborhoods.name: 湾仔 Wan Chai
neighborhoods.vibe: 中环东侧，年轻专业人士聚集，酒吧餐厅多
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 expatexchange 区间 HK$15,000–25,000 中值（HK$20,000÷7.8）

neighborhoods.name: 铜锣湾 Causeway Bay
neighborhoods.vibe: 购物娱乐枢纽，24 小时商圈与深夜小吃
neighborhoods.note: 租金为 expatexchange 区间 HK$15,000–25,000 中值（HK$20,000÷7.8）

neighborhoods.name: 西营盘·坚尼地城 Sai Ying Pun & Kennedy Town
neighborhoods.vibe: 中环以西，咖啡馆/画廊/年轻社区，租金略低
neighborhoods.note: 估算：hkstay 1–2 居区间 HK$20,000–45,000 下沿

sources: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/region_prices_by_city?itemId=26&region=142 — 市中心 1 居 $2,315.73、市郊 $1,772.84（2026-11-16 更新）
